title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a precaution, but normal operations later resumed. The threat involved a masked phone number, a pattern seen in earlier incidents this year.

Gwinnett County school police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to find out who is responsible. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified. The investigation is ongoing, and authorities have not announced any further steps beyond the joint effort with state and federal agencies.
